verdict.rationale: Rippling supports rule-based automated workflows (auto-approvals, provisioning/deprovisioning, attribute mapping, triggered alerts like Slack-from-Zendesk) that run without manual intervention, which is evidence of background automation. However, these are pre-built workflow/rules engines rather than AI-native autonomous agents that a user configures to reason and act independently; missing for 10: explicit support for user-defined autonomous AI agents/automations, evidence of persistent background AI task execution, and any independent corroboration beyond vendor docs.
